backtest_protocol.execution_model: Raw SEC Companyfacts product/service revenue facts are known by filed date (<= signal date). The latest same-concept service, subscription, technology-service, or license-and-service revenue value is compared with its prior same-concept fact roughly one fiscal year earlier, then scaled by current and prior filed annual revenue to require true mix expansion. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

raw SEC companyfacts annual revenue facts

2_history_check.exp-20260615-026: Rejected SEC SaaS/subscription KPI text. This run uses numeric Companyfacts facts known by filed date, not text regex spans.
2_history_check.exp-20260626-002: Accepted measurement repair inventory surfaced product_service Companyfacts tags and showed enough all-history coverage for one fixed PIT tag-surface scout, while also revealing that current standard-window coverage is likely thin and concentrated.
2_history_check.exp-20260626-003: Rejected purchase-obligation maturity-ladder facts. This run uses recognized product/service revenue mix, not supplier/customer purchase commitments.
2_history_check.exp-20260626-004: Rejected completed-divestiture facts. This run uses product/service revenue share growth, not business-sale proceeds or divestiture completion facts.
2_history_check.novelty_gate: Reservation required novelty and saturated-source overrides. The new evidence axis is the exact product_service revenue tag surface from exp-20260626-002, not inventory, warranty, asset growth, purchase-obligation, divestiture, segment-count, customer-concentration, top-N, hold-day, or threshold retuning.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260626-002 surfaced a product_service Companyfacts tag surface and playbook allows segment revenue/profit mix as a materially new axis. Confidence is low because the selected tags are mostly stale or deprecated in the standard windows, the live current coverage is concentrated in InsuranceServicesRevenue, and broad Companyfacts candidate-pool scans are saturated.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw companyfacts product/service revenue tag, stale fact, missing comparable prior same-concept fact, missing current or prior annual revenue scaler, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper and selected Companyfacts daily surface compute the same product/service revenue mix gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
